flows.title: Appearance category renders its complete settings surface
expected: Theme and Text size sections render with their controls.

flows.title: Panes and sidebar category renders its complete settings surface
steps: 1. Open Settings and select Panes & sidebar.
expected: Panes and Sidebar sections render with their controls.

flows.title: Claude sessions category renders its complete settings surface
steps: 1. Open Settings and select Claude sessions.
expected: Session behaviour renders recovery, prompt, and Focus controls.

flows.title: Workflows and models category renders its complete settings surface
steps: 1. Open Settings and select Workflows & models.
expected: Models & fallbacks, Notifications & delivery, Engine automation, and Budgets & resources render.

flows.title: Agents category renders its complete settings surface
expected: The Services section renders with its controls.

flows.title: Credentials category renders its complete settings surface
expected: Provider accounts, Runtime API keys, Auto-switch, Team pool health, and Screen-share safety render.

flows.title: Team pool category renders its complete settings surface
steps: 1. Open Settings and select Team pool.
expected: The team membership and shared credential pool surface renders.

flows.title: Devices and updates category renders its complete settings surface
steps: 1. Open Settings and select Devices & updates.
expected: Pairing & desktop, Updates, and Diagnostics sections render.

flows.title: An exact section deep link opens and focuses the requested section
expected: Settings opens in Appearance with the Text size section focused and visible.

flows.title: An exact control deep link opens and focuses the requested control
expected: Settings opens in Workflows & models with Max heavy operations focused and visible.

flows.title: A legacy deep link resolves to its canonical settings destination
expected: Settings opens at Models & fallbacks and the URL identifies the canonical destination.

flows.title: Settings search finds and navigates to an exact matching control
steps: 1. Search Settings for max heavy operations and select the result.
expected: The matching control result is shown and selecting it focuses Max heavy operations in Budgets & resources.

flows.title: Settings search presents a stable no-match state
steps: 1. Search Settings for a deliberately unknown value such as zzz-no-setting-exists.
expected: A no-results state renders without hiding category navigation or producing an error.
